title: Green chutney - curry starter
preamble:
80g/2¾oz fresh coriander leaves and stalks, washed

20g/¾oz fresh mint leaves, washed

1 garlic clove, peeled and roughly chopped

2.5cm/1in piece fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped

½ small onion, chopped
ingredients: 80g/2¾oz fresh coriander leaves and stalks, washed
1 garlic clove, peeled and roughly chopped
2.5cm/1in piece fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped
1-2 green chillies, or to taste, seeds removed, chopped
15 raw pistachio nuts, shells removed, chopped
2 tbsp lemon juice, or to taste
method: Place all the ingredients into a food processor and blend until smooth.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
